event.text: I've flagged this for Counsel clinician review in this thread today for a sumatriptan refill, since your attack matches your usual pattern and you're out of rescue medication. If review isn't obtained today, contact your pharmacy or usual prescriber for an urgent refill. Seek emergency care now for sudden worst-ever headache, weakness, numbness, speech or vision changes, fever with neck stiffness, or a headache unlike your usual ones.
